standard_prerequisites.name: Zariski glueing of finite presentation spaces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-relative-glueing (same chapter, card L26319, cited at ~4215)
standard_prerequisites.use: FP_S = FP_U x_{FP_{W-setminus{s}}} FP_W for open W containing s.

standard_prerequisites.name: Local ring as colimit over affine neighbourhoods
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-descend-finite-presentation (same chapter, card L26286, cited at ~4224-4225)
standard_prerequisites.use: FP over Spec(O_{S,s}) = lim of FP over the affine neighbourhoods W.

standard_prerequisites.name: Limits of schemes with affine transitions
standard_prerequisites.use: V = lim (W cap U) is a limit of qcqs schemes.

core_obligations: 邻域层面：对含 s 的开 W，lemma-relative-glueing 给 FP_S→FP_U×_{FP_{W\{s}}}FP_W 等价（~4211-4215 行）。

局部环极限：O_{S,s}=colim O_W(W)（W 跑遍 s 的仿射开邻域）⇒ Spec(O_{S,s})=lim W；lemma-descend-finite-presentation 给 FP_{Spec(O_{S,s})} = 各 FP_W 的极限；U→S 拟紧 ⇒ 每个仿射 W 有 U∩W 拟紧，V=lim W∩U=lim W\{s} 是 qcqs 概形极限（limits-lemma-directed-inverse-system-has-limit），故 FP_V = 各 FP_{W∩U} 的极限（~4216-4235 行）。
收尾：把 W 层面的等价对仿射邻域范畴取极限，与上两条极限识别组合即得等价（~4235-4236 行）。
proof_roadmap: W 层面 Zariski 粘合（~4211-4215 行）。
局部环与 V 的极限识别（~4216-4235 行）。
difficulty_reason: 三层极限识别 + 组合全程展示、每步具名锚定；无省略。
